package.description: A simple program to monitor your network/data usage. Made for the average windows user.

en-US.description: A simple program to monitor your network/data usage. Made for the average windows user.
en-US.longDescription: OpenNetMeter monitors your network speed and data usage. It shows the current session's usage, the data usage for today, and detailed usage for any period up to the past 60 days. A mini widget can be placed over the taskbar to display the network speed.
en-US.name: OpenNetMeter

zh-CN.description: 一款简单的网络流量监控程序，为普通 Windows 用户打造。
zh-CN.longDescription: OpenNetMeter 监控您的网络速度和数据流量。它显示当前会话的用量、当日的数据用量，以及最长过去 60 天内任意时间段的详细用量。迷你小组件可以放置在任务栏上方，实时显示网络速度。
